EuroPeir Hub

One job, one screen, one button

EuroPeir’s drivers move roll-off containers between a depot, customers’ sites and disposal plants. Each job used to leave the depot as a paper sheet, and its proof came back on paper too. I designed the app that replaces the sheet: today’s jobs, each one run as a single list of steps, with the proof captured where it happens.

Industry
Industrial waste logistics, Italy
Product
The driver app of EuroPeir Hub, Italian-first, release v0: the only part used outdoors
Role
Lead Product Designer: research, flows and UI
Scope
Driver app on iOS and Android: today’s list, job details, the step timeline, proof, history, support
Users
Drivers standing next to a truck at a depot, a customer’s yard or a disposal plant, usually in the middle of doing something else
Companions
The customer portal and the dispatch console have their own case studies; the overview holds the shared research
1 screen
A job opens once and stays open until the truck is back at the depot
7 steps
One shared list of steps runs all four kinds of driver job
2 photos
A handover is confirmed with a photo of the container and a photo of the signature, inside the step
Offline-ready
Photos and signatures are captured offline and sync when coverage returns
